purpose: HP-W2 implements standalone background describe/derive/verify. Small synthetic image, strict binding, filesystem, process-lock, fault and transport tests cover the new boundary. production.images also verifies shared RP-3 normalization extraction and the necessary GRAY-ICC correction for supported 1/L/LA images; tools audits routing and the authoring rulebook snapshot.
omitted: No additional production.solver/adapter/catalog, native, preflight, delivery or Chromium modules: no solver, adapter, catalog writer, runtime or browser behavior changes. Shared decoder changes are confined to color normalization and directly covered by existing and new image tests; imported path/I/O helpers remain unchanged. No real puzzle replay, image generation, gallery or technical artifact upload. The development core supplies the required Windows player package.

test_changes.reason: Retain small synthetic regression cases for the persistent standalone API and its data integrity; executed only when production.images is selected, not as a new universal CI obligation.
